## Summary

Hanulas, a Riga merchant of Vilnius, led the townspeople who took the castle for Jogaila on 12 Jun 1382 and became first elder of Vilnius (1382-87); in the saga he is [Henė](../forces/shadow_seller.qmd)'s first mask.

## Record vs saga

- **[Record]:** Hanul of Riga (Hennecke, Hannike): took the castle and handed castle and city to Jogaila; Jogaila's deputy in Vilnius 1382-87; took part in the missions before the Act of Krėva; died in Kraków c. 1417-18.
- **[Saga invention]:** Henė's possession of him 1380-82; the sack of Riga silver is only a rumour in Book I.
